notes.title: Supermrket: Zoo
notes.content:
Supermrket expands its Zoo with a new area featuring six different types of apes (including the only Snowflake in the world from Barcelona), and a souvenir area.

- Agendas, T-shirts, Caps, Magnets, Keychains, and Mugs.
